setup.description: Generate or refresh profile/job-profile.md from onboarding information
setup.template: Use the setup-job-profile skill to run profile onboarding for this WhatsApp job search project. Pass $ARGUMENTS through to the skill, including optional --section <name>. Generate or refresh profile/job-profile.md only after user confirmation.

reset.description: Reset local job profile data before running setup again
reset.template: Use the reset-job-profile skill to reset local job profile data in this WhatsApp job search project. Pass $ARGUMENTS through as the optional scope: profile, documents, or all. Do not modify or delete anything until the user confirms by typing exactly RESET.

search-whatsapp-jobs.description: Search WhatsApp job postings through the n8n webhook
search-whatsapp-jobs.template: Use the search-whatsapp-jobs skill to search WhatsApp job postings in this n8n project. Treat $ARGUMENTS as the optional hours value. If $ARGUMENTS is provided, use it as the webhook hours parameter. If it is empty, follow the skill's interactive hours flow. Run the required Docker and webhook workflow, validate output/jobs-email.json, and report lastRun, hoursConsulted, and total.

filter-whatsapp-jobs.description: Filter WhatsApp job postings against the local job profile
filter-whatsapp-jobs.template: Use the filter-whatsapp-jobs skill to filter output/jobs-email.json against profile/job-profile.md. Do not read profile/documents/ or any resumes, CVs, LinkedIn exports, or supplemental files while filtering. Write output/filtered-jobs.json with only compatible jobs, preserve sender, text, and timestamp, add send: false to every kept job, never set send: true, do not add reason, do not modify output/jobs-email.json, validate the result, and report sourceTotal, total, and the output path.

job-search-pipeline.description: Search WhatsApp jobs and then filter them against the local profile
job-search-pipeline.template: Run the full WhatsApp job search pipeline in this n8n project. First use the search-whatsapp-jobs skill with $ARGUMENTS as the optional hours value. If $ARGUMENTS is empty, follow the skill's interactive hours flow. After output/jobs-email.json is valid, use the filter-whatsapp-jobs skill to read profile/job-profile.md and create output/filtered-jobs.json. Do not read profile/documents/ during filtering. Validate both outputs and report lastRun, hoursConsulted, sourceTotal, total, and the output paths.
